title: Natural Hypertrophy: What I picture as my ideal physique
summary: NH describes his goal physique, basically an adult Gon from Hunter x Hunter (with Zodd from Berserk in the tags): huge limbs (arms, forearms, thighs, hamstrings, calves) that can overpower the torso, with neck and traps built to offset his narrow frame and a tight core despite a naturally wide waist. He sees no imbalance to correct, just everything growing together.

claims.claim: NH's ideal physique prioritises big limbs: calves, thighs, hamstrings, and especially biceps, triceps and forearms.
He likes the look of arms bigger than the shoulders and dislikes big round shoulders paired with smaller limbs.
He wants a big back and chest but doesn't mind them being overpowered by his limbs.
Because his frame is narrow with no naturally wide shoulders, he needs a developed neck and traps so he doesn't look skinny up top next to massive arms and legs.
He already has very big arms relative to his torso and doesn't consider it an imbalance to correct; he just wants everything to keep growing together.
He has a naturally wide waist that will never go away, so he keeps it as tight as possible: big legs and arms are pointless with a gut.
He doesn't need a ripped six-pack, only some core definition so the focus stays on the limbs.
His goal physique is essentially adult Gon from Hunter x Hunter; he has a drawing of it to reveal later.
